related_findings.detail: The pack 2019-03-19 ratio 0.9963319491 equals 1/(official 2019 q change 1.0027092929 * tiny 2020 q change 1.0009696351). B5 compares it with the single R1 change 0.9972980276; the 0.09697% gap is below FACTOR_EXACT, so B5 marks the row VERIFIED_REFERENCE even though the 2020 tiny step is already inside the 2019 ratio.

The pack 2026-08-02 ratio 0.1250533301 equals q(2024-03-30) = 1/(3.0030353305 * 2.6628352490), the regime ratio spanning the 2026-07-15 change, the 2026-08-02 change and the 2025/2026-05 tiny steps. B5 compares it with the single R1 change at 2026-08-02 (0.3755395683) and correctly reports CONFLICT_RATIO. The fix is to restore the dropped 2026-07-15 step and use single-step ratios (B11), not to change the threshold.
The manifest dropped a 0.333333 step at 2026-07-15 whose ratio matches the R1 change 3.0 exactly (1/3); B5 already flags it as contradicted by B3. Its effect is absorbed into the 2026-08-02 ratio.
